arxiv-1806-07534.title: Crowdsensing and privacy in smart city applications Journal: Book: Smart Cities, Cybersecurity and Privacy
arxiv-1806-07534.creator: Raj Gaire, Ratan K Ghosh, Jongkil Kim, Alexander Krumpholz, Rajiv Ranjan, RK Shyamasundar, Surya Nepal
arxiv-1806-07534.description: Abstract Smartness in smart cities is achieved by sensing phenomena of interest and using them to make smart decisions. Since the decision makers may not own all the necessary sensing infrastructures, crowdsourced sensing, can help collect important information of the city in near real-time. However, involving people brings of the risk of exposing their private information.

arxiv-1903-08562.title: Cosmological aspects of a hyperbolic solution in f ⁡ ( R , T ) f(R,T) gravity
arxiv-1903-08562.creator: Ritika Nagpal, J. K. Singh, A. Beesham, Hamid Shabani
arxiv-1903-08562.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Ritika Nagpal, J. K. Singh, A. Beesham, Hamid Shabani. This article deals with a cosmological scenario in f ⁡ ( R , T ) f(R,T) gravity for a flat FLRW model of the universe.

arxiv-2103-12362.title: A Sub-Layered Hierarchical Pyramidal Neural Architecture for Facial Expression Recognition
arxiv-2103-12362.creator: Henrique Siqueira, Pablo Barros, Sven Magg, Cornelius Weber and Stefan Wermter Knowledge Technology, Department of Informatics, University of Hamburg, Vogt-Koelln-Str. 30, 22527 Hamburg, Germany Pre-print version of [ 1 ]
arxiv-2103-12362.description: Abstract In domains where computational resources and labeled data are limited, such as in robotics, deep networks with millions of weights might not be the optimal solution. In this paper, we introduce a connectivity scheme for pyramidal architectures to increase their capacity for learning features.

arxiv-2105-07807.title: Islands and current singularities in quasisymmetric toroidal plasmas.
arxiv-2105-07807.creator: E. Rodríguez, A. Bhattacharjee
arxiv-2105-07807.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by E. Rodríguez, A. Bhattacharjee. The presence of current singularities in a quasisymmetric magnetic field is explored. Quasisymmetry is shown effective in isolating Pfirsch-Schlüter singularities, to leading order, to a single magnetic surface resonant with the helicity of the symmetry. The effects of pressure driven currents are analysed, indicating that exclusion of this surface from the plasma volume reduces the potential opening of islands, but does not generally eliminate them completely due to higher order asymmetric geometric effects.

arxiv-2312-10139.title: Constraints on the spectrum of field theories with non-integer O ⁡ ( N ) O(N) symmetry from quantum evanescence
arxiv-2312-10139.creator: Weiguang Cao, Xiaochuan Lu, Tom Melia
arxiv-2312-10139.description: Abstract We identify constraints in the energy spectra of quantum theories that have a global O ⁡ ( N ) O(N) symmetry, where N N is treated as a continuous parameter. We point out that a class of evanescent states fall out of the spectrum at integer values of N N in pairs, via an annihilation mechanism.

arxiv-2403-13139.title: Generating Automatic Feedback on UI Mockups with Large Language Models CCS: Human-centered computing Interactive systems and tools
arxiv-2403-13139.creator: Peitong Duan, Jeremy Warner, Yang Li, Bjoern Hartmann
arxiv-2403-13139.description: Abstract . Feedback on user interface (UI) mockups is crucial in design. However, human feedback is not always readily available. We explore the potential of using large language models for automatic feedback. Specifically, we focus on applying GPT-4 to automate heuristic evaluation , which currently entails a human expert assessing a UI’s compliance with a set of design guidelines.

arxiv-2406-06855.description: Abstract To leverage prediction models to make optimal scheduling decisions in service systems, we must understand how predictive errors impact congestion due to externalities on the delay of other jobs. arxiv-2504-09000.title: CL-CoTNav: Closed-Loop Hierarchical Chain-of-Thought for Zero-Shot Object-Goal Navigation with Vision-Language Models
arxiv-2504-09000.creator: Yuxin Cai, Xiangkun He, Maonan Wang, Hongliang Guo, Wei-Yun Yau, Chen Lv
arxiv-2504-09000.description: Abstract Visual Object Goal Navigation (ObjectNav) requires a robot to locate a target object in an unseen environment using egocentric observations. However, decision-making policies often struggle to transfer to unseen environments and novel target objects, which is the core generalization problem.

arxiv-2511-04751.title: Regularized GLISp for sensor-guided human-in-the-loop optimization footnoteinfo This work is partially supported by the FAIR project (NextGenerationEU, PNRR-PE-AI, M4C2, Investment 1.3), the 4DDS project (Italian Ministry of Enterprises and Made in Italy, grant F/310097/01-04/X56), and the PRIN PNRR
arxiv-2511-04751.creator: Matteo Cercola, Michele Lomuscio, Dario Piga, Simone Formentin
arxiv-2511-04751.description: Abstract Human-in-the-loop calibration is often addressed via preference-based optimization, where algorithms learn from pairwise comparisons rather than explicit cost evaluations. While effective, methods such as Preferential Bayesian Optimization or Global optimization based on active preference learning with radial basis functions (GLISp) treat the system as a black box and ignore informative sensor measurements.

arxiv-2602-19699.title: CACTO-BIC: Scalable Actor-Critic Learning via Biased Sampling and GPU-Accelerated Trajectory Optimization
arxiv-2602-19699.creator: Elisa Alboni, Pietro Noah Crestaz, Elias Fontanari, Andrea Del Prete
arxiv-2602-19699.description: Abstract Trajectory Optimization (TO) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) offer complementary strengths for solving optimal control problems. TO efficiently computes locally optimal solutions but can struggle with non-convexity, while RL is more robust to non-convexity at the cost of significantly higher computational demands.

pmc-10672337.title: Comparative Genomics Reveals Three Genetic Groups of the Whitefly Obligate Endosymbiont Candidatus Portiera aleyrodidarum
pmc-10672337.creator: Teng Lei, Ning Luo, Chao Song, Junwei Yu, Yuhang Zhou, Xin Qi, Yinquan Liu, Christian Stauffer
pmc-10672337.description: Simple SummaryMany obligate endosymbionts colonize an invertebrate host and are directly transferred maternally to the host’s embryo. Consequently, the symbiotic bacteria from diverse host species evolve independently, reflecting the host’s phylogeny. Whiteflies, which consist of thousands of species, harbor obligate endosymbionts of the Portiera genus.

pmc-11620083.title: How do capable village cadres influence the effectiveness of rural living environment improvement? Empirical evidence from China
pmc-11620083.creator: Yuyuan Yi, Ning Zhu, Yifu Zhao, Caiyan Liu
pmc-11620083.description: Rural Living Environment Improvement (RLEI) is crucial for constructing an ecological civilization and revitalizing rural areas. This study conducts an empirical analysis of the influence of capable village cadres on RLEI effectiveness, using microeconomic data from 173 villages across seven Chinese provinces between 2012 and 2019.

pmc-12607289.title: Gut microbiome, stress and interventional strategies using hardy animals
pmc-12607289.creator: Ruqaiyyah Siddiqui, Rizwan Qaisar, Sutherland Maciver, Naveed Ahmed Khan
pmc-12607289.description: The composition of the gut microbiota has been linked to acute stressors, suggesting that modulation of the gut microbiome is a potential avenue for enhancing human health and performance. The gut microbiome exerts its effects through several metabolites, which induce epigenetic and metabolic changes.

pmc-12630874.title: A novel inherently hydrophobic and physicomechanically robust coconut oil-based polyurethane-modified mortar
pmc-12630874.creator: Jason Jon Joshua B Paraguya, Roger G Dingcong, Hernando P Bacosa, Gerard G Dumancas, Arnold C Alguno, Maria Sheila K Ramos, Roberto M Malaluan, Arnold A Lubguban
pmc-12630874.description: Water penetration in mortar structures has long been a significant challenge in the construction industry, resulting in metal bar corrosion, structural deterioration, reduced durability, and increased maintenance costs. Hence, enhancing water resistance is crucial. While surface coatings are common solutions, they are often costly and require frequent maintenance.

pmc-13059498.title: Identification of the IL-1β/miRNA-326 axis as a key regulator of ferroptosis in spinal cord injury
pmc-13059498.creator: Senming Xu, Yangyang Jiang, Yuchang Gui, Jianmin Chen, Qinhe Pan, Minli Jiang, Jianwen Xu
pmc-13059498.description: IntroductionSpinal cord injury (SCI) is a devastating condition with high rates of disability and mortality, and secondary injury mechanisms such as ferroptosis have emerged as crucial contributors to its pathophysiology. However, the regulatory mechanisms underlying ferroptosis in SCI remain largely unclear.

pmc-13237092.title: Enhancing long-term structure in symbolic music generation via a cascaded Skeleton-to-texture framework
pmc-13237092.creator: Yang Yalan
pmc-13237092.description: In the field of symbolic music generation, maintaining macro-structural coherence and preventing logical drift within long sequences remains a critical challenge. Traditional autoregressive models primarily rely on implicit probabilistic statistics to capture contextual dependencies. Consequently, they often struggle to retain memory of initial musical motifs over hundreds of time steps.

pmc-13357116.title: Persistently increased frequency of diabetic ketoacidosis in new-onset type 1 diabetes in Polish children: nationwide analysis 2019–2022
pmc-13357116.creator: Arkadiusz Michalak, Barbara Pernak, Jędrzej Chrzanowski, Iwona Pietrzak, Iwona Beń-Skowronek, Artur Bossowski, Agata Chobot, Maria Bednarska, Katarzyna Dżygało, Wojciech Fendler, Barbara Głowińska-Olszewska, Martyna Górnicka de Almeida, Anita Horodnicka-Józwa, Katarzyna Jakubek-Kipa, Przemysława Jar
pmc-13357116.description: AimsGlobal data show an increase in the rate of diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) at type 1 diabetes (T1D) onset during the COVID-19 pandemic, but its effect on severity remain unclear. This study assessed pre-pandemic, pandemic, and post-pandemic DKA frequency in Polish children with new-onset T1D and evaluated the pandemic’s impact on DKA incidence and severity.
